key.name: kulan-menu
key.description: The Kulan logo at the left of the top bar, with About, Settings, Lock, Restart and Shut Down.

key.name: update-indicator
key.description: An icon in the top bar while updates are waiting or installing.

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: calm = GNOME's own speed, normal = a little quicker (Kulan's default), fast = quicker still.

key.name: automatic-style
key.summary: Switch between light and dark automatically
key.description: Dark from sunset to sunrise (Night Light's schedule when it knows your location, otherwise 19:00 to 07:00).

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: Remember the last 25 things you copied (text only), in memory only, until the screen locks or you log out. Passwords copied from KeePassXC are skipped; passwords copied from a browser are not, which is why this is off by default.

key.name: clipboard-history-shortcut
key.description: Shows what you copied recently; pick one to copy it again.

key.name: live-text-shortcut
key.description: Drag over part of the screen to copy the text in it (recognised on this computer).

key.name: writing-tools-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut for Kulan Assistant's writing tools
key.description: Proofread, rewrite, shorten or translate the selected text (needs Kulan Assistant).

key.name: dictation-shortcut
key.description: Start and stop Dictation: what you say is typed where the cursor is (needs Kulan Assistant).

key.name: search-shortcut
key.description: Opens the search bar (or Activities, depending on search-style).

key.name: search-style
key.description: spotlight: a search bar in the middle of the screen, over your windows. activities: GNOME's Activities overview with its search.

key.name: focus-schedule
key.description: Turn on Do Not Disturb automatically between focus-from and focus-to.

key.name: focus-from
key.description: Hour of the day, such as 22.5 for 22:30.

key.name: focus-active
key.summary: Focus is on because of the schedule
key.description: Set by Kulan Shell while the Focus schedule has Do Not Disturb on, so it is turned off again at the end even after a restart.

key.name: focus-to
key.description: Hour of the day, such as 7.0 for 07:00.

key.name: prayer-times
key.description: Show the next prayer in the top bar and a notification at each prayer time.

key.name: prayer-city
key.description: Shown in the menu; the times come from prayer-latitude and prayer-longitude.

key.name: prayer-country
key.description: Two-letter code, used to suggest the local calculation method.

key.name: prayer-latitude
key.description: Degrees north (negative for south).

key.name: prayer-longitude
key.description: Degrees east (negative for west).

key.name: prayer-method
key.description: Empty: the one used in the chosen city's country.

key.name: prayer-asr
key.description: standard (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali) or hanafi.

key.name: prayer-notify
key.description: A notification and a soft sound when each prayer time comes.
